 the dispenser easily through its funnel mouth. Simply squeeze the silicone head to draw oil up the straw into the transparent space, then gently press to apply oil directly to your pan or food. This feature minimizes countertop messes and the need for frequent refills."}],[{"t":"Easy to Clean and Assemble:","b":true},{"t":" The oil dispenser and brush can be disassembled for thorough cleaning and are just as easy to reassemble. The brush can also be used independently for applying condiments like ketchup or sauces."}],[{"t":"Versatile Kitchen Tool:","b":true},{"t":" Ideal for a variety of cooking tasks, from frying and grilling to baking. Use it to evenly baste meats, vegetables, or pastries with oil, sauces, or marinades, ensuring less waste and uniform distribution."}],[{"t":"Safe and Efficient:","b":true},{"t":" The oil used is kept separate from new oil, preventing contamination. The pipette allows for up to 10ml of controlled oil dispensing."}]]},{"type":"ul","content":["Dimensions: 7.25cm x 22cm ","What's Included: 1 x ODOROKU Kitchen Glass Olive Oil Bottle Pippette with Silicone Brush 180ml"],"li_sub":[[{"t":"Dimensions: 7.25cm x 22cm "}],[{"t":"What's Included: 1 x ODOROKU Kitchen Glass Olive Oil Bottle Pippette with Silicone Brush 180ml"}]]},{"type":"image","image":{"height":1028,"width":790,"uri":"tos-alisg-i-aphluv4xwc-sg/245d7cf74c7f41b6951c800310a184cf","url_list":["https://p19-oec-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-aphluv4xwc-sg/245d7cf74c7f41b6951c800310a184cf~tplv-aphluv4xwc-origin-jpeg.jpeg?dr=15568&t=555f072d&ps=933b5bde&shp=a3510d86&shcp=6ce186a1&idc=my2&from=2739998086","https://p16-oec-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-aphluv4xwc-sg/245d7cf74c7f41b6951c800310a184cf~tplv-aphluv4xwc-origin-jpeg.jpeg?dr=15568&t=555f072d&ps=933b5bde&shp=a3510d86&shcp=6ce186a1&idc=my2&from=2739998086"],"remove_gap":"false"}},{"type":"image","image":{"height":587,"width":790,"uri":"tos-alisg-i-aphluv4xwc-sg/f11bd5d6b34a4594a99253cb84586fc4","url_list":["https://p16-oec-sg.ibyteim
